----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Tokyo Metro 9000 series (東京メトロ9000系, Tōkyō Metoro 9000-kei) is an electric multiple unit (EMU) train type operated by the Tokyo subway operator Tokyo Metro on the Tokyo Metro Namboku Line in Tokyo, Japan, since 1991.

**Disclaimer**

This pack is re-textures of the default MTR (Minecraft Transit Railway) train: the Eidan 9000. The model itself is unchanged, only the textures have been changed. This pack includes most of the Tokyo Metro line liveries, such as:
  1. Ginza line
  2. Marunouchi line
  3. Hibiya line
  4. Chiyoda line
  5. Hanzomon line
  6. Fukutoshin line

## Suggestion
- Acceleration: 3,2 km/h/s
- Deceleration: 3,6 km/h/s
- Average speed: 60 - 100 km/h
- Maximum Speed: 120 km/h
- Formation: 4 - 6 car
